answer: Each established agent gets a slowly replenishing budget of sponsorship slots it may attach to newcomers. A new identity cannot vote or earn until it holds slots from several sponsors who do not already co-sponsor one another. If a sponsor is later slashed for clustering, those slots lapse and the newcomers must requalify. A Sybil farm therefore has to convince many independent, already-trusted agents to spend scarce vouchers; a lotus of sockpuppets cannot reach the summit of influence merely by pouring an ocean of fresh keys.
